criteria.description: The screen after a round shows the garden board with a compact score readout (rank, name, points this round, total) under it, also in the winner view
criteria.verification: board-input.test.ts; manual: Chrome at 390x844 and 320x700, after a round and in the winner view, no sideways scroll

criteria.description: After Confirm, each bunny that scored hops forward one stone at a time, one bunny after another, smallest gain first with ties in seat order
criteria.verification: choreography.test.ts (order, consecutive stones, clamp at finish); motion.test.ts foldStones ends every bunny on stoneForScore(after); manual: play a round with different gains

criteria.description: Hops have squash and stretch and a dust puff on each landing
criteria.verification: motion.test.ts (hop and squash curves); manual: watch a hop in Chrome

criteria.description: A bunny that gained 5 or more spins and throws a burst of petals
criteria.verification: choreography.test.ts (big from 5, cheer at the finish); manual: a round with a 5+ gain

criteria.description: A storyteller who scored 0 droops its ears for a moment
criteria.verification: choreography.test.ts (droop beat); manual: a round where everyone found the card

criteria.description: When the game ends (on the track or with End game), the winner dances and the others clap
criteria.verification: choreography.test.ts (finale only with winners, finale-only plan); board-input.test.ts (winners only when over); manual: win on the track and End game

criteria.description: The camera follows the moving bunny, then settles back on the whole track
criteria.verification: manual: Chrome, watch a round end on the whole-track view; a drag during play stops the follow

criteria.description: A tap on the board or the Skip button puts every bunny on its final stone at once
criteria.verification: controls.test.ts (tap fires on a tap, not on a drag, pinch or pointercancel); manual: tap and button mid-round, positions match the readout

criteria.description: With reduced motion, bunnies glide to their stones with no bounce, effects or camera moves
criteria.verification: motion.test.ts (reduced timeline has no dust, petals, droop, cheer, finale, follow or settle events); manual: matchMedia override before Confirm, and ?board&motion=reduce

criteria.description: The round plays once: Home then Resume, or arming End game, shows final positions without replaying, and the in-game guards still work
criteria.verification: manual: Chrome, Resume and arm End game after a round; pull-to-refresh class and leave-page prompt still set while in game

criteria.description: Tests, typecheck and build pass, and Three.js stays out of the first-load chunk
criteria.verification: npm test && npm run build; check dist main chunk has no three.js
